svg.title: Ask the Earth
svg.desc: Ask the Earth: you ask, the local model picks a tool, the capability broker checks it, the tool fetches public records with their source and time, and a typed request goes to the globe, which confirms it at the backend, app and globe. Anything with consequences waits for your approval. Illustrative artwork; nothing in it is live data.
svg.text: how a question becomes a confirmed action on the globe
No code from the model · invented records are flagged · every source shown with its retrieval time
